name: CSO_BULK_UPDATE_REQUEST
description: This table defines a Bulk Update Batch Job Request.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: REQUEST_NUMBER
columns.description: The human readable identifier of a bulk update request.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added.

columns.name: DATE_STARTED
columns.description: This is the date and time that the bulk update request was actually started.

columns.name: DATE_COMPLETED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the entire Bulk Update Request was completed - inserted only when it is allowed to run until completion.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was modified - updated every time user stops/starts GFR job.

columns.name: SCHEDULED_TIME
columns.description: This is the date and time that the bulk update request will be picked up to be processed.

columns.name: REQUEST_STATE
columns.description: A value which indicates the current state of this Bulk Update job e.g: Stopped, Running, Completed, etc.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: A value which indicates the current status of the bulk update request.

columns.name: REQUEST_TYPE
columns.description: A value which indicates the Bulk Update type.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: A value which indicates what kind of bulk update request this record is.

columns.name: OPERATIONS
columns.description: A value which indicates which operations (e.g. add categories, change owner, etc) are to be performed as part of the bulk update request.

columns.name: SITE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the Site (Repository) in which this Bulk Update Request was made.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID reference to the user who made the Bulk Update Request.

columns.name: CONTENT_CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the channel where the Bulk Update Request was made.

columns.name: LAST_MODIFIED_BY
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID associate with the user who last modified the build update request.

columns.name: PARAMETER_XML
columns.description: The job parameters marshalled as XMl.

columns.name: STATUS_XML
columns.description: The job status marshalled as XML.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user who made the Bulk Update Request.

columns.name: LAST_MODIFIED_BY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user who last modified the build update request.

columns.name: PARAMETER_DATA
columns.description: The bulk update request parameter data (i.e operations, values for operations, etc) that details the changes that will be performed.

columns.name: STATUS_DATA
columns.description: The bulk update status data that contains the bulk update request processing information.

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: The stripe code of the department that this bulk update request can modify articles in.  In other words, only articles that belong to the department indicated here will be modified.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: A value that contains a user's comments related to the bulk update request.

columns.name: SELECTED_NUM
columns.description: This value is the number of articles that were selected to be modified by this bulk update request.

columns.name: SUCCESS_NUM
columns.description: This value is the number of articles that were successfully modified by the bulk update request.

columns.name: SKIPPED_NUM
columns.description: This value is the number of articles that were explicitly skipped due to various reasons during the bulk update process.

columns.name: ERROR_NUM
columns.description: This value is the number of articles that resulted in an error when the bulk update process attempted to update.

columns.name: CLUSTER_NAME
columns.description: This value is used to describe the current cluster that this item is being processed in.

columns.name: POD_NAME
columns.description: This value is used to describe what current pod this is being processed in.
